reason: I have to buy a site anyway, it is on my consultant's list, and this is the first offer where I don't have to write a single text or chase anyone for an acceptance report; 800 out of a 46,000 grant is not where I will lose sleep. I'd forward it to my consultant tonight and if she says the invoice wording works, I sign.
objection: He is a LEADER beneficiary, not Start-Up Nation, and my programme has its own checklist; if his acceptance report or invoice description is one line off, the expense gets cut and I pay 800 from my own pocket. And the 'no reply in 5 working days counts as accepted' clause worries me, because I am exactly the person who doesn't reply in 5 days.
would_change_my_mind: If my consultant says his delivery documents don't match what Start-Up Nation asks for, or that she already has a supplier whose paperwork she knows gets through, I go with hers without a second thought.
